violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed raw shelled eggs (57F) stored out at room temp on prep counter near flat grill on cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: CFM relocated raw shelled to Kolpak walk in refrigerator to cool to 41F. CFM agreed to keep raw shelled eggs in preptop refrigerator in between use.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Observed 2 unlabeled working chemical spray bottles with a common name near 3 vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CDI: CFM labeled working chemical spray bottles.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: card board used to line shelf near 3 vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. CDI: CFM discarded cardboard from shelf.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: Observed cooking equipment stored in hand sink located in the kitchen area, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CDI: CFM removed equipment from hand sink.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Observed raw shelled eggs stored above cups of RTE chopped watermelon inside of 2 dr preptop cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: CFM relocated shelled to bottom shelf of prep top cooler.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Observed debris on the interior of ice machine in the kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. CDI: CFM cleaned the interior of the ice machine. SIMPLY SOCIAL COFFEE (Inspection Date: 07/10/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor.ObSERVED FOOD STIRED ON THE FLOOR IN THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR AND IN THE DRUY STORAGE AREA
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food. FEMAL EMPLOYEES ON THE COOK-LINE OBSERVED WEARING BRACELETS .
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed that SINGLE SERVICE CARRYOUT BOXES WERE STORED ON THE FLOOR IN THE BACK STORAGE ROOM .were they may be exposed to contamination.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. PROVIDE MORE SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS TO ELEVATE SUPPLIES OFF THE FLOORS.
